simple.meaning: יׇגְבְּהָה (Yogbᵉhâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “Jogbehah , a place East of the Jordan.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.

definitions.short: Jogbehah , a place East of the Jordan
definitions.full: H3011. Yogbehah יָגְבְּהָה proper name ( exalted ? Ol § 277 k. 4 ) place in the tribe of Gad Num 32:35 ; Judg 8:11 ; — –irbet-Ajbêhât , northwest from `Ammân, Bd Pal 189 .

occurrences.englishText: Gideon went up by the way of those who lived in tents on the east of Nobah and Jogbehah, and struck the army; for the army felt secure.
